notes: REF-BM-10: tags are a plain comma-separated text input; no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: tag search in the query uses `tag:name` syntax, not the required `#tag` token — typing `#tag` falls through to a literal substring word match, so the specified syntax is not realized though the tag-in-query capability exists. REF-BM-23: markdown notes can be written/stored/edited but are never rendered (no markdown library) nor even displayed in any view — only shown raw in the edit textarea. REF-BM-24: local HTML snapshot is captured (page.content() + screenshot) but it is a raw HTML file, not a self-contained single-file archive, and the PDF rule (store the PDF when the URL is a PDF) is not implemented — chromium is always launched. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive / archive.org submission anywhere. REF-BM-30: Netscape import reads href/title/TAGS but never parses ADD_DATE, so date-added is not preserved (imported items get current timestamp).
